This is modeled as a role-weighted vector space where each signal S_i is associated with a role R_i. The weighted blend math then synthesizes these signals using fixed weights w_i, forming a consensus signal \hat{S}. The honesty ledger ensures that all components of this system are tracked for implementation fidelity, enabling retroactive validation and error correction.
